summary.text: Carolyn Hugley is the House Minority Leader and represents Georgia House District 141; she was elected in 1992.

paragraphs.text: She served as House Minority Whip from 2003 to 2018.

Hugley was born in Forrest City, Arkansas, earned a bachelor's degree in political science, was awarded a Master of Public Policy and Administration by Mississippi State University, and is a State Farm insurance agent in Columbus, Georgia.
